fun.warned: Oh no, I told you: do not touch. Now take responsibility.
fun.back: You're back. I knew you'd come back.
fun.line.1: What does this button do? And this one? And this one?
fun.line.2: Single responsibility: you touched it, you own it.
fun.line.3: Relax, I know what I'm doing. Kidding.
fun.line.5: Ignore me and I poke harder.
fun.line.6: Seen my CV yet? I'll poke it for you.
fun.line.7: This click counts. This one doesn't. This one does.
fun.line.8: Coffee? No? Fine, I'll keep poking.
fun.line.9: Not leaving until you find the button. Hint: down there.
fun.line.10: Kicking me out? I just got here. One more minute.
fun.line.11: You know me by now. And you still touched it.
fun.beg: Not yet. I still have {seconds} seconds of annoying left.
fun.sulk: Fine, I'll stay still. But I'm watching you.
fun.bye: Okay, I'll calm down. For now.
